ko.title: 70년 만에 가장 강력한 엘니뇨, 내년 식료품비에 이미 반영되고 있다

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: 기상 충격과 식료품 가격은 서로 다른 시계로 움직입니다.

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: 바다는 올해 따뜻해지지만, 매장 가격은 내년에 조정됩니다.

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: 태평양의 온도 이상 현상과 영수증 하단의 숫자 사이에 존재하는 약 12~18개월의 간극은, 현재 적도 태평양에서 형성 중인 엘니뇨에 대해 이해해야 할 가장 중요한 핵심입니다.

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: 예보관들은 이번 현상이 최소 70년 만에 가장 강력한 수준에 속할 것으로 예상합니다.

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: 유엔 세계식량계획(WFP)은 예상대로 전개될 경우, **45개국에서 이미 식량 불안정 상태로 분류된 2억 2,500만 명**에 더해, **2027년 말까지 약 4,900만 명의 사람들이 추가로 극심한 기아 상태**에 빠질 수 있다고 경고했습니다.

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: 이에 대응하여 WFP는 단 한 번의 수확 실패가 발생하기 전인 '선제적' 구호를 위해 약 **8,000만 달러를 투입**하고 있다고 밝혔습니다.

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: 이 마지막 세부 사항이 바로 핵심입니다.

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: 인도주의적 구호 기관들은 보통 재난이 닥치기 전에 예산을 집행하지 않습니다.

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: 그들이 그렇게 한다는 것은 주의 깊게 읽어볼 만한 신호입니다.

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## 엘니뇨가 실제로 일으키는 일

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: 엘니뇨는 열대 태평양 중부와 동부의 표층 해수가 주기적으로 온난화되는 현상입니다.

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: 따뜻한 바닷물은 대기의 가장 깊은 대류가 일어나는 위치를 변화시키며, 이 변화는 전 세계 강수량 지도를 함께 끌고 갑니다.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: 이 패턴은 균일하지 않으며, 모든 곳에 나쁘게 작용하는 것도 아닙니다:

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **평소보다 건조함:** 인도네시아, 말레이시아, 필리핀, 호주 동부, 아프리카 남부, 중앙아메리카 일부 및 남미 북부, 그리고 종종 인도 몬순 지대.

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **평소보다 습함:** 미국 남부, 아프리카의 뿔 지역, 페루 및 에콰도르 해안, 아르헨티나 일부 및 브라질 남부.

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **평소보다 따뜻함:** 바다가 저장된 열을 시차를 두고 방출하기 때문에, 보통 정점 *다음 해*에 전 세계 평균 기온이 급증합니다.

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: 따라서 강력한 엘니뇨가 곧 전 지구적 가뭄을 의미하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: 그것은 '재배치'이며, 이 재배치는 오차 범위가 좁은 작물을 재배하고 비축량이 적은 지역에 가장 가혹하게 작용합니다.

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## 피해가 늦게 나타나는 이유

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: 직관적인 모델은 틀렸습니다.

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들은 폭풍이 치고, 밭이 망가지고, 그다음 주에 매장 선반이 비는 모습을 상상합니다.

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: 농업 시스템은 그런 식으로 무너지지 않습니다.

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: 실제 순서는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | 단계 | 대략적인 시기 | 일어나는 일 |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | 해수 온난화, 현상 정점 | 2026년 말 – 2027년 초 | 강수 패턴 변화; 가시적인 식량 영향은 적음 |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | 파종 시기 교란 | 2027년 초~중반 | 농민들이 늦게 심거나, 적게 심거나, 다른 작물을 심음 |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | 수확량 감소 | 2027년 중~후반 | 수확량 하락; 가계가 판매 대신 자체 비축분을 소비함 |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **식량 부족기(Lean season)** | **2027년 말 – 2028년 초** | 다음 수확 전 비축분 고갈; 지역적으로 가격 급등 |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: **식량 부족기**는 한 번의 수확으로 얻은 비축분이 바닥나고 다음 수확이 돌아오기까지의 간격을 말합니다.

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: 아프리카 남부의 많은 지역에서는 대략 10월부터 3월까지가 이에 해당합니다.

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: 평소보다 40% 적게 수확한 가구는 7월에는 이를 느끼지 못합니다. 곡간이 비고 다른 모든 이들의 곡간도 비어 시장 가격이 이미 올랐을 때인 12월에야 비로소 체감하게 됩니다.

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: 이것이 WFP가 명시한 타임라인이 2026년이 아니라 **2027~28년**을 가리키는 이유입니다.

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: 현상은 지금 일어나고 있습니다.

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: 그 결과는 이미 예정되어 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## 미국 식료품 카트까지 도달하는 경로

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: 미국 소비자들은 이러한 영향의 대부분으로부터 격리되어 있지만, 전부는 아닙니다.

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: 세 가지 사항을 구분해서 볼 필요가 있습니다.

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: 소매 가격에서 농가 수취 가격이 차지하는 비중은 작습니다.** 시리얼 한 상자나 빵 한 덩어리의 경우, 원곡물 가격은 보통 소비자가 지불하는 금액의 한 자릿수 후반에서 두 자릿수 초반 퍼센트에 불과합니다.

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: 인건비, 포장비, 운송비, 에너지 비용 및 소매 마진이 지배적입니다.

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: 밀 선물 가격이 30% 변동한다고 해서 계산대 가격이 30% 변동하는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: 일부 품목은 다른 품목보다 훨씬 더 노출되어 있습니다.** 다음과 같은 품목은 원자재 비중이 훨씬 높고, 재배 지역이 엘니뇨에 훨씬 더 민감합니다:

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **커피** (브라질, 베트남, 인도네시아)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **코코아** (강수 시기가 매우 중요한 서아프리카)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **팜유 및 식물성 기름** (인도네시아와 말레이시아, 두 곳 모두 전형적인 엘니뇨 건조 신호 지역)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **쌀** (인도 및 동남아시아; 또한 수출 제한 조치가 가장 빈번한 품목)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **설탕** (인도, 태국, 브라질)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **향신료, 견과류 및 열대 과일**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: 이 품목들이 태평양의 이상 현상이 미국 소매 시장에서 가장 뚜렷하게 나타나는 항목들입니다.

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: 정책이 날씨보다 더 큰 증폭 효과를 냅니다.** 지난 10년 동안 가장 급격한 식료품 가격 변동은 단순히 수확량 부족만으로 발생한 경우가 드물었습니다.

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: 그것들은 수확량 부족에 '수출 금지'가 더해졌을 때 발생했습니다.

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: 주요 쌀 또는 밀 수출국이 국내 공급을 보호하기 위해 출하를 제한하면, 세계 가격은 나쁜 몬순 한 시즌이 움직이는 것보다 일주일 만에 더 많이 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: 강수량만큼이나 무역 정책을 면밀히 관찰하십시오.

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: 네 번째의 더 조용한 경로인 **물류**가 있습니다. 파나마 운하 유역의 강수량 감소는 이전에 흘수 제한과 통과 경매를 강제하여, 영향을 받은 작물과 전혀 상관없는 경로의 운송 비용을 높였습니다.

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: 해운은 모든 것에 들어가는 비용 요소입니다.

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## 아무것도 망가지기 전에 8,000만 달러를 쓰는 이유

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: '선제적 조치(Anticipatory action)'는 인도주의적 관행에서 비교적 최근의 변화이며, 그 논리는 단순한 산수입니다.

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: 충격 *전*에 쓰는 돈은 충격 *후*에 쓰는 돈과 다른 것을 삽니다.

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: 사전에 투입되는 돈은 가뭄 저항성 종자, 소규모 관개 시설 수리, 가축을 살리기 위한 수의학적 지원, 가족들이 생산 자산을 팔지 않도록 돕는 현금 지원, 그리고 도로가 유실되기 전에 도달할 수 있는 창고에 미리 배치된 곡물을 확보하는 데 쓰입니다.

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: 사후에 투입되는 돈은 긴급 항공 수송과 치료용 급식에 쓰이는데, 이는 목록 중 가장 비용이 많이 드는 개입이며 물류적으로 가장 어려운 시점에 전달됩니다.

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: 조기 경보 기반 금융 시스템을 운영하는 기관들은 일반적으로 사전 배치된 1달러가 위기 후의 1달러보다 훨씬 더 큰 효과를 낸다는 것을 발견했습니다. 또한 수치화하기 어려운 두 번째 효과가 있는데, 식량 부족기를 견디기 위해 소, 종자, 지붕을 팔지 않아도 되는 가구는 회복하는 데 5년이 아니라 1년밖에 걸리지 않는다는 점입니다.

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: 궁지에 몰려 자산을 매각하는 것이 단 한 번의 흉작을 10년의 빈곤으로 만드는 경로입니다.

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: 제약은 분석 능력이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: 문제는 선제적 자금 지원을 위해 기부자들이 사진이 찍히기 전, 이야기가 신문 1면에 나기 전인 '예측' 단계에서 돈을 내놓아야 한다는 점입니다.

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: 이는 제도적으로 정말 어려운 요구이며, 그렇기에 8,000만 달러라는 금액이 예상 필요 규모에 비해 작음에도 불구하고 주목할 만한 숫자입니다.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## 내년에 실제로 주목해야 할 것

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: 이 상황이 예측대로 흘러가는지 추적하고 싶다면, 몇 가지 지표가 대부분의 정보를 담고 있습니다:

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - NOAA 기후예측센터가 발표하는 **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) 값** — 현상의 강도를 측정하는 표준 척도이며, '70년 만에 가장 강력한'이라는 말이 유지될지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **6월~9월 사이 인도 몬순의 성과**, 그리고 이에 대응해 인도의 쌀 수출 정책이 변하는지 여부.

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **FAO의 월간 식량가격지수**, 특히 식물성 기름과 곡물 하위 지수.

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - 대략 11월부터 나오는 **아프리카 남부 파종 보고서** — 2027년 생산량에 대한 첫 번째 확실한 증거가 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - 쌀, 밀, 식물성 기름 상위 5개 수출국에서 발표하는 **어떠한 수출 제한 조치**.

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## 솔직한 주의 사항

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: 계절 예보는 확률적이지 결정론적이지 않습니다.

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: 몇 가지 기억해 둘 점이 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **강도가 곧바로 영향으로 이어지지는 않습니다.** 2015~16년 현상은 매우 강력했습니다. 1997~98년 현상은 일부 척도로 더 강력했지만 지역적 피해 패턴은 달랐습니다. 태평양의 어느 지점에 온난화 이상 현상이 위치하느냐가 얼마나 뜨거워지느냐만큼 중요합니다.

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **이득을 보는 지역도 있습니다.** 엘니뇨 해에는 아르헨티나, 미국 남부 일부, 아프리카의 뿔 지역에 더 좋은 강수량이 나타나는 경우가 많습니다. 글로벌 공급망은 부분적으로 자체 헤징이 가능합니다.

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **시장은 적응합니다.** 농민들은 작물을 바꾸고, 수입업자들은 선도 구매를 하며, 예측에서 부족해 보였던 재고가 예측 기간이 오기 전에 다시 채워지는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **예상 수치는 시나리오 추정치입니다.** 4,900만 명이라는 숫자는 설정된 가정하에 모델링된 투영치이지 측정값이 아닙니다. 이 수치는 수정될 것이며, 양방향 모두로 가능성이 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: 여기서 가장 유용한 관점의 전환은, 기후 현상과 식량 위기가 단순히 시간차를 둔 같은 것이 아니라, '결정'에 의해 갈라진다는 점입니다.

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: 2027년의 강수량 이상 현상이 2028년의 기아 비상사태가 될지는 종자 가용성, 저장 시설, 신용 접근성, 무역 정책, 그리고 가구들이 회복에 필요한 자산을 팔기 시작하기 전후에 선제적 원조가 도착하느냐에 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: 미국 쇼핑객들에게 실질적인 기대치는 낮고 불균등합니다. 카트의 대부분 품목에는 가시적인 변동이 거의 없겠지만, 커피, 초콜릿, 식용유, 쌀, 설탕에서는 더 뚜렷한 압박이 있을 것입니다. 이는 올해보다는 2027년 말에 나타날 것이며, 아직 아무도 예측할 수 없는 무역 정책에 크게 좌우될 것입니다.

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: WFP가 이미 식량 불안정 상태로 집계한 2억 2,500만 명의 사람들에게 이 문제는 퍼센트 포인트로 측정되는 것이 아닙니다.

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: 한 대륙에서는 반올림 오차에 불과한 것이 다른 대륙에서는 식량 부족기가 되는 이러한 비대칭성이야말로, 이번 예보가 가장 명확하게 보여주는 지점입니다.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or investment advice.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 목적으로 하며, 금융 또는 투자 조언이 아닙니다.

segments.src: Figures cited reflect projections published by the World Food Programme and are subject to revision; readers should consult WFP, FAO, and NOAA primary sources for current data.*
segments.tr: 인용된 수치는 세계식량계획(WFP)이 발표한 투영치를 반영하며 수정될 수 있습니다. 최신 데이터는 WFP, FAO, NOAA의 기본 자료를 참조하십시오.*

zh.title: 70年最强厄尔尼诺现象已在预演明年的食品账单

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: 天气冲击和杂货价格运行在不同的时间轴上。

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: 海洋在今年变暖，货架价格在明年调整。

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: 这种差距——太平洋温度异常与收据底部的数字之间大约 12 到 18 个月的时间差——是理解目前在赤道太平洋形成的厄尔尼诺现象最关键的一点。

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: 预报员预计此次事件将成为至少 70 年来最强的一次。

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: 联合国世界粮食计划署 (WFP) 警告称，如果按照预期发展，到 2027 年底，可能会有**额外 4900 万人陷入严重饥饿**，而目前在 45 个国家中已有 **2.25 亿人被归类为粮食不安全**。

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: 作为回应，该机构表示将投入约 **8000 万美元用于“前瞻性”救济**——在任何一次收获失败之前就投入资金。

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: 最后这个细节就是故事的核心。

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: 人道主义机构通常不会在灾难发生前支出。

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: 当他们这样做时，这是一个值得仔细阅读的信号。

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## 厄尔尼诺现象实际上在做什么

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: 厄尔尼诺现象是热带太平洋中部和东部海表水的周期性变暖。

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: 暖水改变了大气层最深处对流的位置，这种转移随之带动了全球降雨图的改变。

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: 这种模式并非统一，且并非全部是负面的：

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **比正常情况更干燥：** 印度尼西亚、马来西亚、菲律宾、澳大利亚东部、非洲南部、中美洲部分地区和南美洲北部，以及通常的印度季风带。

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **比正常情况更湿润：** 美国南部、非洲之角、秘鲁和厄瓜多尔沿海、阿根廷部分地区和巴西南部。

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **比正常情况更温暖：** 全球平均气温通常在峰值*之后*的一年飙升，因为海洋释放储存的热量具有滞后性。

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: 因此，强厄尔尼诺现象并非全球性的干旱。

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: 它是一种*重新洗牌*——而这种重新洗牌恰好最沉重地落在那些作物容错率低且储备匮乏的地区。

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## 为什么损害在后期才到来

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: 直觉模型是错误的。

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: 大多数人想象的是一场风暴，一片被毁的农田，以及次周空空如也的货架。

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: 农业系统并非如此崩溃。

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: 实际的顺序如下：

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | 阶段 | 大约时间 | 发生的事情 |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | 海洋变暖，事件达到峰值 | 2026 年底 – 2027 年初 | 降雨模式改变；粮食影响不明显 |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | 播种季节受干扰 | 2027 年初至中期 | 农民播种较晚，播种量减少，或种植不同作物 |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | 收获量不足 | 2027 年中期至后期 | 产量下降；家庭食用自有库存而非出售 |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **歉收季 (Lean season)** | **2027 年底 – 2028 年初** | 在下次收获前库存耗尽；当地价格飙升 |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: **歉收季**是指一次收获的储备耗尽与下一次收获到来之间的时间间隔。

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: 在非洲南部大部分地区，这个时间段大约从 10 月到次年 3 月。

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: 一个收获量比平时少 40% 的家庭在 7 月份不会感觉到影响——而是在 12 月份感觉到，此时粮仓已空，且由于其他人的粮仓也空了，市场价格已经上涨。

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: 这就是为什么 WFP 声明的时间线指向 **2027–28 年**，而不是 2026 年。

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: 事件现在正在发生。

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: 后果则已在日程表上。

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## 它是如何影响到美国杂货车的

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: 美国消费者在很大程度上被隔绝在这些影响之外——但并非全部。

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: 有三件事值得区分。

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: 零售价格中农场出厂价的份额较小。** 对于一盒谷物片或一条面包，原材料谷物的成本通常仅占你支付金额的个位数到低两位数百分比。

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: 劳动力、包装、运输、能源和零售利润占据主导地位。

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: 小麦期货上涨 30% 并不意味着收银台的价格也会上涨 30%。

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: 某些类别的暴露程度远高于其他类别。** 对于以下产品，大宗商品份额更高，且种植区对厄尔尼诺现象更敏感：

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **咖啡** (巴西, 越南, 印度尼西亚)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **可可** (西非，那里的降雨时机至关重要)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **棕榈油和植物油** (印度尼西亚和马来西亚，两者都是典型的厄尔尼诺干旱信号区)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **大米** (印度和东南亚；也是最容易受到出口限制影响的类别)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **糖** (印度, 泰国, 巴西)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **香料、坚果和热带水果**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: 这些是太平洋异常现象在美国零售端最明显体现的项目。

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: 政策的影响比天气的影响更大。** 过去十年中最剧烈的食品价格波动很少仅由收获不足引起。

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: 它们是由不足 *加上* 出口禁令引起的。

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: 当主要的大米或小麦出口国为了保护国内供应而限制发货时，世界价格在一周内波动幅度可能超过一场糟糕的季风在整个季节带来的波动。

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: 关注贸易政策的紧密程度应至少与关注降雨量相当。

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: 第四个更安静的渠道：**物流。** 巴拿马运河集水区降雨量减少此前曾迫使采取吃水限制和过境拍卖，从而提高了与受影响作物无关的航线上的运费。

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: 航运是所有产品的成本投入。

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## 为什么在任何事情崩溃前投入 8000 万美元

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: “前瞻性行动”是人道主义实践中一个相对较新的转变，其逻辑是简单的算术。

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: 在冲击*之前*投入的资金与冲击之后投入的资金能买到不同的东西。

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: 在此之前，它可以购买耐旱种子、小规模灌溉修复、维持牲畜生存的兽医支持、让家庭避免出售生产性资产的现金转移，以及在道路被冲毁前可触及的仓库中预置粮食。

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: 在此之后，它购买的是紧急空运和治疗性喂养——这些是目录中最昂贵的干预措施，且在物流难度最大的时候交付。

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: 从事早期预警触发融资的机构通常发现，预置的美元比危机后的美元效果好得多，而且还有第二个难以量化的影响：那些不需要通过出售牛、种子库存或房顶来度过歉收季的家庭，恢复时间是一年而不是五年。

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: 绝望中的资产出售是单次收获失败如何演变为十年贫困的原因。

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: 限制不在于分析。

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: 而在于前瞻性资金要求捐赠者根据预测释放资金——在有照片、在故事登上任何头版之前。

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: 这是一个真正困难的机构要求，这就是为什么 8000 万美元是一个值得注意的数字，尽管相对于预计的需求规模来说它很小。

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## 未来一年实际应该关注什么

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: 如果你想追踪这次事件是否如预测般演变，几个指标承载了大部分信息：

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - **ONI (海洋尼诺指数) 值**，由 NOAA 的气候预测中心发布——这是衡量事件强度的标准衡量方法，也是决定“70 年最强”是否成立的指标。

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **印度季风 6 月至 9 月的表现**，以及印度是否会据此调整大米出口政策。

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **FAO 的每月食品价格指数**，尤其是植物油和谷类子指数。

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - **非洲南部播种报告**，大约从 11 月起——这是关于 2027 年产量的第一个硬证据。

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - **任何前五大出口国（大米、小麦或植物油）宣布的出口限制**。

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## 诚实的免责声明

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: 季节性预测是概率性的，而非决定性的。

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: 有几件事值得记住：

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **强度并不直接等同于影响。** 2015–16 年的事件非常强；1997–98 年的事件在某些衡量标准下更强，但产生了不同的区域损害模式。暖异常区在太平洋中的位置与温度高低同样重要。

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **某些地区会获益。** 厄尔尼诺年份通常给阿根廷、美国南部部分地区和非洲之角带来更好的降雨量。全球供应可以部分自我对冲。

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **市场会适应。** 农民会更换作物，进口商会提前购买，且在预测视野到来之前，看起来匮乏的库存经常被重建。

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **预测数字是情景估计。** 4900 万这个数字是一个在特定假设下的模型预测，而非测量值。它将被修订——很可能在两个方向上。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 结论

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: 这里最有效的重新定义是：气候事件和粮食危机并非被时间分开，而是被*决定*分开。

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: 2027 年的降雨异常是否会变成 2028 年的饥饿紧急情况，取决于种子的可用性、存储、信贷获取、贸易政策，以及预置援助是否在家庭开始出售他们恢复所需的东西之前到来。

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: 对于美国购物者来说，实际的预期是适度且不均匀的：大多数购物车的商品几乎没有可见的波动，但在咖啡、巧克力、食用油、大米和糖方面压力更明显——这将在 2027 年底而非今年到来，且严重依赖于目前没人能预测的贸易政策。

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: 对于 WFP 已经将其归类为粮食不安全的 2.25 亿人来说，赌注并非以百分比计算。

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: 这种不对称性——在一个大洲是舍入误差，在另一个大洲是歉收季——正是这次预测让可见的最清晰的一点。

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or investment advice.
segments.tr: *本文为一般信息，不构成财务或投资建议。

segments.src: Figures cited reflect projections published by the World Food Programme and are subject to revision; readers should consult WFP, FAO, and NOAA primary sources for current data.*
segments.tr: 引用的数字反映了世界粮食计划署发布的预测，可能会有所修订；读者应参考 WFP、FAO 和 NOAA 的原始资料以获取最新数据。*

hi.title: 70 वर्षों में सबसे शक्तिशाली अल नीनो का असर अगले साल के खाद्य बिलों पर पहले से ही पड़ रहा है

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: मौसम के झटके और किराने की कीमतों की समय-सीमा अलग-अलग होती है।

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: महासागर इस साल गर्म होता है; दुकानों में कीमतें अगले साल बदलती हैं।

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: वह अंतर — प्रशांत महासागर के तापमान की विसंगति और रसीद के निचले हिस्से में लिखे नंबर के बीच लगभग बारह से अठारह महीने — भूमध्यरेखीय प्रशांत में बन रहे अल नीनो के बारे में समझने वाली सबसे महत्वपूर्ण बात है।

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: पूर्वानुमानकर्ताओं को उम्मीद है कि यह घटना कम से कम सात दशकों में सबसे शक्तिशाली घटनाओं में से एक होगी।

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: संयुक्त राष्ट्र विश्व खाद्य कार्यक्रम (WFP) ने चेतावनी दी है कि यदि यह अनुमान के अनुसार विकसित होता है, तो यह **2027 के अंत तक लगभग 49 मिलियन अतिरिक्त लोगों को गंभीर भूख की स्थिति में धकेल सकता है**, जो कि **45 देशों में पहले से ही खाद्य-असुरक्षित वर्गीकृत 225 मिलियन लोगों** के ऊपर एक अतिरिक्त बोझ होगा।

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: इसके जवाब में, एजेंसी का कहना है कि वह लगभग **$80 मिलियन "पूर्वानुमानित" राहत (anticipatory relief)** के लिए प्रतिबद्ध कर रही है — वह पैसा जो एक भी फसल खराब होने से पहले खर्च किया जाता है।

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: यही आखिरी विवरण असली कहानी है।

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: मानवीय एजेंसियां आमतौर पर आपदा से पहले खर्च नहीं करती हैं।

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: जब वे ऐसा करती हैं, तो यह एक ऐसा संकेत है जिसे ध्यान से पढ़ने की जरूरत है।

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## अल नीनो वास्तव में क्या करता है

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: अल नीनो मध्य और पूर्वी उष्णकटिबंधीय प्रशांत के सतही जल का एक आवधिक गर्म होना है।

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: गर्म पानी उस स्थान को बदल देता है जहाँ वायुमंडल का सबसे गहरा संवहन (convection) होता है, और यह बदलाव वैश्विक वर्षा मानचित्र को अपने साथ खींच लेता है।

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: यह पैटर्न एक समान नहीं है, और यह हर जगह बुरा नहीं है:

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **सामान्य से अधिक शुष्क:** इंडोनेशिया, मलेशिया, फिलीपींस, पूर्वी ऑस्ट्रेलिया, दक्षिणी अफ्रीका, मध्य अमेरिका और उत्तरी दक्षिण अमेरिका के कुछ हिस्से, और अक्सर भारतीय मानसून बेल्ट।

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **सामान्य से अधिक गीला:** दक्षिणी संयुक्त राज्य अमेरिका, अफ्रीका का हॉर्न, तटीय पेरू और इक्वाडोर, अर्जेंटीना के कुछ हिस्से और दक्षिणी ब्राजील।

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **सामान्य से अधिक गर्म:** वैश्विक औसत तापमान आमतौर पर चरम (peak) के *अगले* वर्ष में बढ़ जाता है, क्योंकि महासागर संग्रहीत गर्मी को देरी से छोड़ता है।

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: इसलिए एक शक्तिशाली अल नीनो वैश्विक सूखा नहीं है।

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: यह एक *पुनर्गठन (reshuffling)* है — और यह पुनर्गठन उन क्षेत्रों पर सबसे अधिक प्रभाव डालता है जो ऐसी फसलें उगाते हैं जिनमें गलती की गुंजाइश बहुत कम होती है और जिनके पास बहुत कम भंडार होता है।

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## नुकसान देर से क्यों आता है

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: सहज मॉडल गलत है।

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: ज्यादातर लोग एक तूफान, एक बर्बाद खेत और अगले हफ्ते खाली अलमारियों की कल्पना करते हैं।

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: कृषि प्रणालियाँ इस तरह विफल नहीं होती हैं।

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: वास्तविक क्रम यहाँ है:

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | चरण | लगभग कब | क्या होता है |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | महासागर गर्म होता है, घटना चरम पर होती है | 2026 के अंत - 2027 की शुरुआत | वर्षा के पैटर्न बदलते हैं; भोजन पर बहुत कम दृश्य प्रभाव |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | बुआई का मौसम बाधित होता है | 2027 की शुरुआत-मध्य | किसान देर से बुआई करते हैं, कम बुआई करते हैं, या अलग फसल उगाते हैं |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | फसल कम होती है | 2027 मध्य-अंत | पैदावार गिरती है; परिवार बेचने के बजाय अपना स्टॉक खाते हैं |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **लीन सीजन (Lean season)** | **2027 के अंत - 2028 की शुरुआत** | अगली फसल से पहले स्टॉक खत्म हो जाता है; स्थानीय स्तर पर कीमतें बढ़ जाती हैं |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: **लीन सीजन** एक फसल के भंडार के खत्म होने और अगली फसल के आने के बीच का अंतराल है।

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: दक्षिणी अफ्रीका के अधिकांश हिस्सों में यह लगभग अक्टूबर से मार्च तक चलता है।

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: एक परिवार जिसने सामान्य से 40% कम फसल काटी, उसे जुलाई में इसका अहसास नहीं होता — उसे दिसंबर में महसूस होता है, जब अनाज भंडार खाली होता है और बाजार की कीमत पहले ही बढ़ चुकी होती है क्योंकि बाकी सभी के भंडार भी खाली होते हैं।

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि WFP की बताई गई समय-सीमा **2027–28** की ओर इशारा करती है, न कि 2026 की।

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: घटना अभी हो रही है।

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: परिणाम निर्धारित (scheduled) है।

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## यह अमेरिकी किराने की टोकरी तक कैसे पहुँचता है

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी उपभोक्ता इनमें से अधिकांश से सुरक्षित हैं — लेकिन पूरी तरह से नहीं।

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: तीन चीजों को अलग करना जरूरी है।

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: खुदरा मूल्य में फार्म-गेट हिस्सा छोटा होता है।** अनाज के एक डिब्बे या ब्रेड के एक लोफ के लिए, कच्चा अनाज आमतौर पर आपके द्वारा भुगतान की गई राशि का कम एकल-अंक या कम द्वि-अंक प्रतिशत होता है।

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: श्रम, पैकेजिंग, परिवहन, ऊर्जा और खुदरा मार्जिन का प्रभुत्व होता है।

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: गेहूं के वायदा (futures) में 30% की हलचल कैश काउंटर पर 30% की हलचल नहीं बनती।

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: कुछ श्रेणियां दूसरों की तुलना में कहीं अधिक संवेदनशील होती हैं।** कमोडिटी हिस्सा बहुत अधिक होता है — और उगाने वाले क्षेत्र अल नीनो के प्रति बहुत अधिक संवेदनशील होते हैं — इनके लिए:

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **कॉफी** (ब्राजील, वियतनाम, इंडोनेशिया)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **कोको** (पश्चिम अफ्रीका, जहाँ वर्षा का समय बहुत मायने रखता है)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **पाम और वनस्पति तेल** (इंडोनेशिया और मलेशिया, दोनों ही क्लासिक अल नीनो शुष्क-संकेत क्षेत्र हैं)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **चावल** (भारत और दक्षिण पूर्व एशिया; साथ ही वह श्रेणी जो निर्यात प्रतिबंधों के प्रति सबसे अधिक प्रवण है)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **चीनी** (भारत, थाईलैंड, ब्राजील)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **मसाले, मेवे और उष्णकटिबंधीय फल**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: ये वे आइटम हैं जहाँ प्रशांत विसंगति अमेरिकी खुदरा बाजार में सबसे स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई देती है।

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: नीति मौसम की तुलना में अधिक प्रभाव डालती है।** पिछले दशक की खाद्य कीमतों में सबसे तीव्र हलचल शायद ही कभी केवल फसल की कमी के कारण हुई थी।

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: वे कमी *प्लस* निर्यात प्रतिबंध के कारण हुए थे।

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: जब एक प्रमुख चावल या गेहूं निर्यातक घरेलू आपूर्ति की रक्षा के लिए शिपमेंट प्रतिबंधित करता है, तो वैश्विक कीमतें एक सप्ताह में उतनी बदल सकती हैं जितना एक खराब मानसून एक पूरे सीजन में बदलता है।

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: वर्षा के साथ-साथ व्यापार नीति पर भी उतनी ही बारीकी से नजर रखें।

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: एक चौथा, शांत चैनल: **लॉजिस्टिक्स।** पनामा नहर जलक्षेत्र में कम वर्षा ने पहले ड्राफ्ट प्रतिबंधों और ट्रांजिट नीलामियों को मजबूर किया है, जिससे उन मार्गों पर माल ढुलाई लागत बढ़ गई है जिनका प्रभावित फसल से कोई लेना-देना नहीं है।

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: शिपिंग हर चीज के लिए एक लागत इनपुट है।

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## कुछ भी खराब होने से पहले $80 मिलियन क्यों खर्च करें

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: "पूर्वानुमानित कार्रवाई" (Anticipatory action) मानवीय अभ्यास में एक अपेक्षाकृत हालिया बदलाव है, और इसका तर्क सीधा अंकगणित है।

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: झटके से *पहले* खर्च किया गया पैसा उन चीजों को खरीदता है जो झटके के बाद खर्च किए गए पैसे से अलग होती हैं।

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: पहले, यह सूखा-सहिष्णु बीज, छोटे पैमाने पर सिंचाई मरम्मत, पशुधन को जीवित रखने के लिए पशु चिकित्सा सहायता, नकद हस्तांतरण जो परिवारों को उत्पादक संपत्तियों को बेचने से बचने देते हैं, और गोदामों में पहले से रखे गए अनाज खरीदता है जहाँ सड़कें बह जाने से पहले पहुँचा जा सके।

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: बाद में, यह आपातकालीन एयरलिफ्ट और चिकित्सीय भोजन खरीदता है — जो सूची में सबसे महंगे हस्तक्षेप हैं, और अधिकतम लॉजिस्टिक कठिनाई के बिंदु पर वितरित किए जाते हैं।

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: प्रारंभिक चेतावनी-ट्रिगर वित्तपोषण पर काम करने वाली एजेंसियों ने आम तौर पर पाया है कि पहले से तैनात डॉलर संकट के बाद के डॉलर की तुलना में काफी अधिक प्रभावी होता है, और एक दूसरा प्रभाव है जिसे quantify करना कठिन है: जिन परिवारों को लीन सीजन में जीवित रहने के लिए अपने बैल, अपने बीज स्टॉक या अपनी छत नहीं बेचनी पड़ती, वे पांच साल के बजाय एक साल में उबर जाते हैं।

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: मजबूरी में संपत्तियों की बिक्री ही वह तरीका है जिससे एक खराब फसल गरीबी के एक दशक में बदल जाती है।

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: बाधा विश्लेषण नहीं है।

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: यह है कि पूर्वानुमानित वित्तपोषण के लिए दाताओं को पूर्वानुमान के आधार पर पैसा जारी करने की आवश्यकता होती है — इससे पहले कि तस्वीरें आएं, और इससे पहले कि कहानी किसी फ्रंट पेज पर हो।

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: यह वास्तव में एक कठिन संस्थागत मांग है, यही कारण है कि $80 मिलियन एक उल्लेखनीय संख्या है, भले ही यह अनुमानित आवश्यकता के पैमाने के मुकाबले छोटी हो।

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## अगले वर्ष वास्तव में क्या देखना है

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: यदि आप यह ट्रैक करना चाहते हैं कि क्या यह पूर्वानुमान के अनुसार होता है, तो कुछ संकेतक अधिकांश जानकारी देते हैं:

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - NOAA के क्लाइमेट प्रेडिक्शन सेंटर द्वारा प्रकाशित **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) मान** — घटना की ताकत का मानक माप, और वह जो यह निर्धारित करता है कि "70 वर्षों में सबसे शक्तिशाली" बात सही साबित होती है या नहीं।

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **भारतीय मानसून का जून-सितंबर प्रदर्शन**, और क्या भारत की चावल निर्यात नीति इसके जवाब में बदलती है।

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **FAO का मासिक खाद्य मूल्य सूचकांक**, विशेष रूप से वनस्पति तेल और अनाज उप-सूचकांक।

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - लगभग नवंबर से **दक्षिणी अफ्रीकी बुआई रिपोर्ट** — 2027 के उत्पादन पर पहला ठोस सबूत।

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - चावल, गेहूं या वनस्पति तेल के शीर्ष पांच निर्यातकों में से किसी द्वारा **घोषित कोई भी निर्यात प्रतिबंध**।

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## ईमानदार चेतावनियाँ

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: मौसमी पूर्वानुमान संभाव्य (probabilistic) होते हैं, नियतात्मक (deterministic) नहीं।

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: कुछ बातें याद रखने योग्य हैं:

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **शक्ति का सीधा संबंध प्रभाव से नहीं होता।** 2015-16 की घटना बहुत शक्तिशाली थी; 1997-98 की घटना कुछ पैमानों पर और भी अधिक शक्तिशाली थी लेकिन उसने एक अलग क्षेत्रीय क्षति पैटर्न पैदा किया। प्रशांत महासागर में गर्म विसंगति कहाँ स्थित है, यह उतना ही मायने रखता है जितना कि वह कितनी गर्म होती है।

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **कुछ क्षेत्रों को लाभ होता है।** अल नीनो वर्ष अक्सर अर्जेंटीना, अमेरिकी दक्षिण के कुछ हिस्सों और अफ्रीका के हॉर्न में बेहतर वर्षा लाते हैं। वैश्विक आपूर्ति आंशिक रूप से स्वयं को हेज (self-hedge) कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **बाजार अनुकूलन करते हैं।** किसान फसलें बदलते हैं, आयातक अग्रिम खरीदारी करते हैं, और जो स्टॉक पूर्वानुमान में कम दिखते हैं, वे अक्सर पूर्वानुमान क्षितिज आने से पहले फिर से बन जाते हैं।

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **अनुमानित आंकड़े परिदृश्य अनुमान हैं।** 49 मिलियन की संख्या बताए गए मान्यताओं के तहत एक मॉडल किया गया अनुमान है, माप नहीं। इसे संशोधित किया जाएगा — संभवतः दोनों दिशाओं में।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: यहाँ सबसे उपयोगी पुनर्गठन यह है कि जलवायु घटना और खाद्य संकट एक ही चीज नहीं हैं जो समय से अलग हों — वे *निर्णयों* द्वारा अलग होते हैं।

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: क्या 2027 में वर्षा की विसंगति 2028 में भूख की आपात स्थिति बन जाती है, यह बीजों की उपलब्धता, भंडारण, ऋण पहुंच, व्यापार नीति और इस बात पर निर्भर करता है कि पहले से तैनात सहायता परिवारों द्वारा अपनी रिकवरी के लिए आवश्यक चीजों को बेचने से पहले आती है या बाद में।

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: अमेरिकी खरीदारों के लिए, व्यावहारिक उम्मीद मामूली और असमान है: टोकरी के अधिकांश हिस्सों में बहुत कम दृश्य हलचल, कॉफी, चॉकलेट, कुकिंग ऑयल, चावल और चीनी में अधिक ध्यान देने योग्य दबाव — जो इस साल के बजाय 2027 के अंत में आएगा, और भारी रूप से उस व्यापार नीति पर निर्भर करेगा जिसका अभी कोई पूर्वानुमान नहीं लगा सकता।

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: उन 225 मिलियन लोगों के लिए जिन्हें WFP पहले से ही खाद्य-असुरक्षित मानता है, दांव प्रतिशत अंकों में नहीं मापे जाते।

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: यह विषमता — एक महाद्वीप पर एक मामूली त्रुटि, दूसरे पर एक लीन सीजन — वह सबसे स्पष्ट चीज है जिसे यह पूर्वानुमान दृश्यमान बनाता है।

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or investment advice.
segments.tr: *यह लेख सामान्य जानकारी है, वित्तीय या निवेश सलाह नहीं है।

segments.src: Figures cited reflect projections published by the World Food Programme and are subject to revision; readers should consult WFP, FAO, and NOAA primary sources for current data.*
segments.tr: उद्धृत आंकड़े विश्व खाद्य कार्यक्रम द्वारा प्रकाशित अनुमानों को दर्शाते हैं और संशोधन के अधीन हैं; पाठकों को वर्तमान डेटा के लिए WFP, FAO और NOAA प्राथमिक स्रोतों से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

es.title: El Niño más fuerte en 70 años ya se está reflejando en la factura de alimentos del próximo año

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: Los choques climáticos y los precios de los comestibles funcionan con relojes diferentes.

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: El océano se calienta este año; el estante de la tienda cambia de precio el próximo año.

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: Esa brecha —aproximadamente de doce a dieciocho meses entre una anomalía de temperatura en el Pacífico y el número al final de un recibo— es lo más importante que hay que entender sobre el fenómeno de El Niño que se está formando actualmente en el Pacífico ecuatorial.

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: Los pronosticadores esperan que este evento se sitúe entre los más fuertes en al menos siete décadas.

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: El Programa Mundial de Alimentos (PMA) de las Naciones Unidas ha advertido que, si se desarrolla según lo previsto, podría empujar a aproximadamente **49 millones de personas adicionales a una situación de hambre aguda para finales de 2027**, sumándose a los **225 millones que ya están clasificados como inseguros alimentariamente en 45 países**.

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: En respuesta, la agencia afirma que está destinando unos **80 millones de dólares a ayuda "anticipatoria"**, dinero gastado antes de que falle una sola cosecha.

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: Ese último detalle es la clave de la historia.

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: Las agencias humanitarias no suelen gastar antes de un desastre.

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: Cuando lo hacen, es una señal que conviene leer con atención.

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## Qué hace realmente El Niño

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: El Niño es un calentamiento periódico de las aguas superficiales en el centro y este del Pacífico tropical.

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: El agua cálida desplaza el lugar donde se encuentra la convección más profunda de la atmósfera, y ese desplazamiento arrastra consigo el mapa global de precipitaciones.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: El patrón no es uniforme y no es uniformemente malo:

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **Más seco de lo normal:** Indonesia, Malasia, Filipinas, el este de Australia, el sur de África, partes de Centroamérica y el norte de Sudamérica, y a menudo el cinturón del monzón indio.

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **Más húmedo de lo normal:** el sur de Estados Unidos, el Cuerno de África, las costas de Perú y Ecuador, partes de Argentina y el sur de Brasil.

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **Más cálido de lo normal:** las temperaturas medias globales suelen dispararse el año *siguiente* al pico, porque el océano libera el calor almacenado con un retraso.

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: Por lo tanto, un El Niño fuerte no es una sequía global.

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: Es una *redistribución* —y esa redistribución suele afectar más duramente a las regiones que cultivan productos con márgenes de error estrechos y poseen pocas reservas.

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## Por qué el daño llega tarde

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: El modelo intuitivo es incorrecto.

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: La mayoría de la gente imagina una tormenta, un campo arruinado y estantes vacíos la semana siguiente.

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: Los sistemas agrícolas no fallan de esa manera.

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: Esta es la secuencia real:

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | Etapa | Aproximadamente cuándo | Qué sucede |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | El océano se calienta, el evento alcanza su pico | Finales de 2026 – principios de 2027 | Los patrones de lluvia cambian; poco impacto visible en los alimentos |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | La temporada de siembra se ve alterada | Principios–mediados de 2027 | Los agricultores siembran tarde, siembran menos o siembran un cultivo diferente |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | La cosecha es insuficiente | Mediados–finales de 2027 | Los rendimientos caen; los hogares consumen sus propias reservas en lugar de vender |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **Temporada de escasez** | **Finales de 2027 – principios de 2028** | Las reservas se agotan antes de la siguiente cosecha; los precios suben localmente |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: La **temporada de escasez** es el intervalo entre el agotamiento de las reservas de una cosecha y la llegada de la siguiente.

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: En gran parte del sur de África, transcurre aproximadamente de octubre a marzo.

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: Un hogar que cosechó un 40% menos de lo habitual no lo siente en julio; lo siente en diciembre, cuando el granero está vacío y el precio de mercado ya ha subido porque el granero de todos los demás también está vacío.

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: Es por esto que el cronograma establecido por el PMA apunta a **2027–28**, no a 2026.

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: El evento está ocurriendo ahora.

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: La consecuencia está programada.

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## Cómo llega al carrito de compras de EE. UU.

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: Los consumidores estadounidenses están aislados de la mayor parte de esto, pero no de todo.

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: Vale la pena separar tres cosas.

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: La proporción del precio minorista que corresponde a la granja es pequeña.** Para una caja de cereal o una hogaza de pan, el grano bruto suele representar un porcentaje de un solo dígito bajo o un doble dígito bajo de lo que se paga.

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: La mano de obra, el embalaje, el transporte, la energía y el margen minorista predominan.

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: Un movimiento del 30% en los futuros del trigo no se convierte en un movimiento del 30% en la caja registradora.

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: Algunas categorías están mucho más expuestas que otras.** La proporción de materias primas es mucho más alta —y las regiones de cultivo mucho más sensibles a El Niño— para:

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **Café** (Brasil, Vietnam, Indonesia)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **Cacao** (África Occidental, donde el momento de las lluvias importa enormemente)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **Aceites de palma y vegetales** (Indonesia y Malasia, ambas regiones clásicas de señal de sequía de El Niño)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **Arroz** (India y el Sudeste Asiático; también la categoría más propensa a restricciones de exportación)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **Azúcar** (India, Tailandia, Brasil)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **Especias, frutos secos y frutas tropicales**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: Estos son los artículos donde una anomalía del Pacífico se muestra más legiblemente en el comercio minorista de EE. UU.

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: La política amplifica más que el clima.** Los movimientos más bruscos de los precios de los alimentos en la última década rara vez fueron causados únicamente por una insuficiencia de la cosecha.

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: Fueron causados por una insuficiencia *más* una prohibición de exportación.

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: Cuando un importante exportador de arroz o trigo restringe los envíos para proteger el suministro interno, los precios mundiales pueden moverse más en una semana que lo que un mal monzón los mueve en una temporada.

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: Observe la política comercial al menos tan de cerca como las lluvias.

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: Un cuarto canal, más silencioso: **la logística.** La reducción de las lluvias en la cuenca del Canal de Panamá ha obligado anteriormente a restricciones de calado y subastas de tránsito, aumentando los costos de flete en rutas que no tienen nada que ver con el cultivo afectado.

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: El transporte es un insumo de costo para todo.

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## Por qué gastar 80 millones de dólares antes de que algo se rompa

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: La "acción anticipatoria" es un cambio relativamente reciente en la práctica humanitaria, y la lógica es una aritmética sencilla.

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: El dinero gastado *antes* de un choque compra cosas diferentes que el dinero gastado después.

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: De antemano, compra semillas resistentes a la sequía, reparación de riego a pequeña escala, apoyo veterinario para mantener vivo al ganado, transferencias de efectivo que permiten a las familias evitar la venta de activos productivos y grano preposicionado en almacenes accesibles antes de que los caminos se laven.

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: Después, compra puentes aéreos de emergencia y alimentación terapéutica —las intervenciones más caras del catálogo, entregadas en el punto de máxima dificultad logística.

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: Las agencias que trabajan en el financiamiento activado por alertas tempranas generalmente han descubierto que el dólar preposicionado rinde considerablemente más que el dólar postcrisis, y hay un segundo efecto que es más difícil de cuantificar: los hogares que no tienen que vender sus bueyes, sus semillas o su techo para sobrevivir a una temporada de escasez se recuperan en un año en lugar de cinco.

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: Las ventas de activos por desesperación son la forma en que una sola mala cosecha se convierte en una década de pobreza.

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: La restricción no es el análisis.

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: Es que el financiamiento anticipatorio requiere que los donantes liberen dinero basándose en un pronóstico, antes de que haya fotos y antes de que la historia esté en cualquier portada.

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: Esa es una solicitud institucional genuinamente difícil, razón por la cual 80 millones de dólares es una cifra notable, aunque sea pequeña frente a la escala de la necesidad proyectada.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## Qué observar realmente durante el próximo año

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: Si desea rastrear si esto sucede según lo previsto, unos pocos indicadores contienen la mayor parte de la información:

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - **Valores ONI (Índice Oceánico del Niño) publicados por el Centro de Predicción Climática de la NOAA** — la medida estándar de la fuerza del evento, y la que determina si se mantiene lo de "el más fuerte en 70 años".

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **El desempeño del monzón indio de junio a septiembre**, y si la política de exportación de arroz de la India cambia en respuesta.

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **El Índice de Precios de los Alimentos mensual de la FAO**, especialmente los subíndices de aceites vegetales y cereales.

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - **Informes de siembra del sur de África** desde aproximadamente noviembre en adelante — la primera evidencia sólida sobre la producción de 2027.

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - **Cualquier restricción de exportación anunciada** por uno de los cinco principales exportadores de arroz, trigo o aceite vegetal.

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## Las advertencias honestas

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: Los pronósticos estacionales son probabilísticos, no deterministas.

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: Vale la pena tener en cuenta algunas cosas:

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **La fuerza no se traduce directamente en impacto.** El evento de 2015–16 fue muy fuerte; el evento de 1997–98 fue aún más fuerte según algunas medidas, pero produjo un patrón de daño regional diferente. El lugar donde se encuentra la anomalía cálida en el Pacífico importa tanto como cuánto se calienta.

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **Algunas regiones ganan.** Los años de El Niño a menudo traen mejores lluvias a Argentina, partes del sur de EE. UU. y el Cuerno de África. El suministro global puede auto-coberturarse parcialmente.

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **Los mercados se adaptan.** Los agricultores cambian de cultivos, los importadores compran a futuro y las existencias que parecen escasas en un pronóstico frecuentemente se reconstruyen antes de que llegue el horizonte del pronóstico.

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Las cifras proyectadas son estimaciones de escenarios.** La cifra de 49 millones es una proyección modelada bajo supuestos establecidos, no una medición. Será revisada, posiblemente en ambas direcciones.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: El replanteamiento más útil aquí es que un evento climático y una crisis alimentaria no son lo mismo separados por el tiempo, sino que están separados por *decisiones*.

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: Que una anomalía de lluvia en 2027 se convierta en una emergencia de hambre en 2028 depende de la disponibilidad de semillas, el almacenamiento, el acceso al crédito, la política comercial y de si la ayuda preposicionada llega antes o después de que los hogares comiencen a vender lo que necesitan para recuperarse.

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: Para los compradores de EE. UU., la expectativa práctica es modesta y desigual: poco movimiento visible en la mayor parte del carrito, con una presión más notable en el café, el chocolate, los aceites de cocina, el arroz y el azúcar, llegando a finales de 2027 en lugar de este año, y dependiendo fuertemente de la política comercial que nadie puede pronosticar todavía.

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: Para los 225 millones de personas que el PMA ya cuenta como inseguros alimentariamente, lo que está en juego no se mide en puntos porcentuales.

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: Esa asimetría —un error de redondeo en un continente, una temporada de escasez en otro— es lo más claro que este pronóstico hace visible.

segments.tr: *Este artículo es información general, no un consejo financiero o de inversión.
