ar.title: أقوى ظاهرة نينيو في 70 عاماً بدأت تؤثر بالفعل على أسعار الغذاء للعام المقبل

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: تعمل صدمات الطقس وأسعار البقالة وفق جداول زمنية مختلفة.

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: يسخن المحيط هذا العام؛ وتتغير الأسعار على الرفوف في العام المقبل.

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: هذه الفجوة - حوالي اثني عشر إلى ثمانية عشر شهراً بين شذوذ درجة حرارة المحيط الهادئ والرقم الموجود في أسفل الإيصال - هي أهم شيء يجب فهمه بشأن ظاهرة النينيو التي تتشكل الآن في المحيط الهادئ الاستوائي.

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: يتوقع المتنبئون أن يكون هذا الحدث من بين الأقوى في سبعة عقود على الأقل.

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: حذر برنامج الأغذية العالمي (WFP) التابع للأمم المتحدة من أنه إذا تطور الأمر كما هو متوقع، فقد يدفع بحوالي **49 مليون شخص إضافي إلى حالة الجوع الحاد بحلول نهاية عام 2027**، وذلك بالإضافة إلى **225 مليون شخص مصنفين بالفعل على أنهم يعانون من انعدام الأمن الغذائي في 45 دولة**.

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: واستجابة لذلك، تقول الوكالة إنها تخصص حوالي **80 مليون دولار للإغاثة "الاستباقية"** - وهي أموال تُنفق قبل فشل محصول واحد.

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: هذه التفصيلة الأخيرة هي جوهر القصة.

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: عادة لا تنفق الوكالات الإنسانية الأموال قبل وقوع الكارثة.

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: وعندما يفعلون ذلك، فإنها تكون إشارة تستحق القراءة بعناية.

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## ما تفعله ظاهرة النينيو فعلياً

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: النينيو هي ظاهرة دورية من ارتفاع درجة حرارة المياه السطحية في وسط وشرق المحيط الهادئ الاستوائي.

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: تؤدي المياه الدافئة إلى تغيير مكان أعمق حمل حراري في الغلاف الجوي، وهذا التغيير يسحب معه خريطة هطول الأمطار العالمية.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: النمط ليس موحداً، وليس سيئاً بشكل موحد:

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **أكثر جفافاً من المعتاد:** إندونيسيا، ماليزيا، الفلبين، شرق أستراليا، جنوب أفريقيا، أجزاء من أمريكا الوسطى وشمال أمريكا الجنوبية، وغالباً حزام الرياح الموسمية الهندية.

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **أكثر رطوبة من المعتاد:** جنوب الولايات المتحدة، القرن الأفريقي، سواحل بيرو والإكوادور، أجزاء من الأرجنتين وجنوب البرازيل.

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **أكثر دفئاً من المعتاد:** عادة ما ترتفع متوسطات درجات الحرارة العالمية في العام *الذي يلي* الذروة، لأن المحيط يطلق الحرارة المخزنة بتأخر.

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: لذا، فإن ظاهرة نينيو قوية ليست جفافاً عالمياً.

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: بل هي *إعادة توزيع* - وهذه إعادة التوزيع تقع بقوة على المناطق التي تزرع محاصيل ذات هوامش خطأ ضيقة وتمتلك احتياطيات قليلة.

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## لماذا يصل الضرر متأخراً

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: النموذج البديهي خاطئ.

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: يتخيل معظم الناس عاصفة، وحقلاً مدمراً، ورفوفاً فارغة في الأسبوع التالي.

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: الأنظمة الزراعية لا تفشل بهذه الطريقة.

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: إليك التسلسل الفعلي:

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | المرحلة | التوقيت التقريبي | ماذا يحدث |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | يسخن المحيط، وتصل الظاهرة لذروتها | أواخر 2026 - أوائل 2027 | تتغير أنماط هطول الأمطار؛ تأثير غذائي بسيط مرئي |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | اضطراب موسم الزراعة | أوائل-منتصف 2027 | يزرع المزارعون متأخراً، أو يزرعون كميات أقل، أو يزرعون محصولاً مختلفاً |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | نقص في الحصاد | منتصف-أواخر 2027 | تنخفض الغلال؛ تستهلك الأسر مخزونها بدلاً من بيعه |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **موسم العجاف** | **أواخر 2027 - أوائل 2028** | تنفد المخزونات قبل الحصاد التالي؛ ترتفع الأسعار محلياً |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: إن **موسم العجاف** هو الفترة الفاصلة بين نفاد مخزونات حصاد واحد ووصول الحصاد التالي.

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: في معظم أنحاء جنوب أفريقيا، يمتد هذا الموسم تقريباً من أكتوبر إلى مارس.

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: الأسرة التي حصدت أقل بنسبة 40% من المعتاد لا تشعر بذلك في يوليو - بل تشعر به في ديسمبر، عندما تكون الصومعة فارغة وسعر السوق قد ارتفع بالفعل لأن صوامع الجميع الآخرين فارغة أيضاً.

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: هذا هو السبب في أن الجدول الزمني المعلن لبرنامج الأغذية العالمي يشير إلى **2027-28**، وليس 2026.

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: الحدث يقع الآن.

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: لكن النتيجة مجدولة.

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## كيف يصل ذلك إلى عربة تسوق في الولايات المتحدة

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: المستهلكون الأمريكيون معزولون عن معظم هذا - ولكن ليس كله.

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: هناك ثلاثة أشياء تستحق الفصل بينها.

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: حصة سعر المزرعة في سعر التجزئة صغيرة.** بالنسبة لعلبة حبوب الإفطار أو رغيف الخبز، عادة ما تكون الحبوب الخام نسبة مئوية منخفضة من خانة الآحاد أو بداية خانة العشرات مما تدفعه.

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: تهيمن تكاليف العمالة، والتغليف، والنقل، والطاقة، وهامش التجزئة.

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: تحرك بنسبة 30% في العقود الآجلة للقمح لا يتحول إلى تحرك بنسبة 30% عند صندوق الدفع.

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: بعض الفئات أكثر عرضة من غيرها.** تكون حصة السلع أعلى بكثير - والمناطق الزراعية أكثر حساسية لظاهرة النينيو - بالنسبة لـ:

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **القهوة** (البرازيل، فيتنام، إندونيسيا)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **الكاكاو** (غرب أفريقيا، حيث توقيت هطول الأمطار مهم للغاية)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **زيوت النخيل والنباتية** (إندونيسيا وماليزيا، وكلاهما مناطق إشارات جفاف كلاسيكية للنينيو)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **الأرز** (الهند وجنوب شرق آسيا؛ وهي أيضاً الفئة الأكثر عرضة لقيود التصدير)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **السكر** (الهند، تايلاند، البرازيل)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **التوابل والمكسرات والفواكه الاستوائية**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: هذه هي البنود التي يظهر فيها شذوذ المحيط الهادئ بشكل أكثر وضوحاً في تجارة التجزئة الأمريكية.

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: السياسة تضخم التأثير أكثر من الطقس.** نادراً ما كانت تحركات أسعار الغذاء الحادة في العقد الماضي ناتجة عن نقص الحصاد وحده.

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: بل كانت ناتجة عن نقص *بالإضافة إلى* حظر التصدير.

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: عندما يقوم مصدر رئيسي للأرز أو القمح بتقييد الشحنات لحماية الإمدادات المحلية، يمكن أن تتحرك الأسعار العالمية في أسبوع واحد أكثر مما يحركها موسم أمطار سيئ في موسم كامل.

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: راقب السياسة التجارية بنفس الدقة التي تراقب بها هطول الأمطار.

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: هناك قناة رابعة، أكثر هدوءاً: **الخدمات اللوجستية.** أدى انخفاض هطول الأمطار في حوض قناة بنما سابقاً إلى فرض قيود على الغاطس ومزادات العبور، مما رفع تكاليف الشحن على الطرق التي لا علاقة لها بالمحصول المتأثر.

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: الشحن هو مدخل تكلفة لكل شيء.

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## لماذا يتم إنفاق 80 مليون دولار قبل حدوث أي انهيار

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: يعد "العمل الاستباقي" تحولاً حديثاً نسبياً في الممارسة الإنسانية، والمنطق هو حسابات حسابية بسيطة.

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: الأموال التي تُنفق *قبل* الصدمة تشتري أشياء مختلفة عن الأموال التي تُنفق بعدها.

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: قبل ذلك، تشتري بذوراً مقاومة للجفاف، وإصلاحات صغيرة لنظم الري، ودعماً بيطرياً للحفاظ على الماشية على قيد الحياة، وتحويلات نقدية تسمح للعائلات بتجنب بيع الأصول الإنتاجية، وحبوباً يتم تخزينها مسبقاً في مستودعات يمكن الوصول إليها قبل أن تجرف المياه الطرق.

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: أما بعد ذلك، فهي تشتري عمليات نقل جوي طارئة وتغذية علاجية - وهي التدخلات الأكثر تكلفة في القائمة، والتي يتم تقديمها في نقطة أقصى صعوبة لوجستية.

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: وجدت الوكالات التي تعمل على التمويل المرتبط بإنذارات مبكرة أن الدولار الموضع مسبقاً يذهب إلى أبعد من الدولار الذي يأتي بعد الأزمة، وهناك تأثير ثانٍ يصعب قياسه كمياً: الأسر التي لا تضطر لبيع ثيرانها أو مخزونها من البذور أو سقف منزلها للنجاة من موسم العجاف تتعافى في عام واحد بدلاً من خمسة.

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: بيع الأصول تحت الضغط هو كيف يصبح الحصاد السيئ الواحد عقداً من الفقر.

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: العائق ليس في التحليل.

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: بل في أن التمويل الاستباقي يتطلب من المانحين إطلاق الأموال بناءً على توقعات - قبل أن تكون هناك صور، وقبل أن تكون القصة على أي صفحة أولى.

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: هذا طلب مؤسسي صعب حقاً، ولهذا السبب يعد مبلغ 80 مليون دولار رقماً ملحوظاً رغم صغره مقارنة بحجم الاحتياجات المتوقعة.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يجب مراقبته فعلياً خلال العام المقبل

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: إذا كنت تريد تتبع ما إذا كان هذا سيحدث كما هو متوقع، فإن مجموعة من المؤشرات تحمل معظم المعلومات:

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - **قيم ONI (مؤشر نينيو المحيطي)** التي ينشرها مركز تنبؤ المناخ التابع لـ NOAA - المقياس القياسي لقوة الحدث، وهو الذي يحدد ما إذا كانت عبارة "الأقوى في 70 عاماً" ستظل قائمة.

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **أداء الرياح الموسمية الهندية من يونيو إلى سبتمبر**، وما إذا كانت سياسة تصدير الأرز في الهند ستتغير استجابة لذلك.

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **مؤشر أسعار الغذاء الشهري لمنظمة الفاو (FAO)**، وخاصة المؤشرات الفرعية للزيوت النباتية والحبوب.

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - **تقارير الزراعة في جنوب أفريقيا** بدءاً من نوفمبر تقريباً - أول دليل ملموس على إنتاج عام 2027.

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - **أي قيود تصدير معلنة** من أحد أكبر خمسة مصدرين للأرز أو القمح أو الزيوت النباتية.

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## التحذيرات الصادقة

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: التوقعات الموسمية احتمالية وليست حتمية.

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: هناك بعض الأشياء التي تستحق التذكر:

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **القوة لا تعني بالضرورة التأثير.** كان حدث 2015-16 قوياً جداً؛ وكان حدث 1997-98 أقوى وفقاً لبعض المقاييس ولكن أنتج نمط ضرر إقليمي مختلف.

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **بعض المناطق تستفيد.** غالباً ما تجلب سنوات النينيو أمطاراً أفضل للأرجنتين وأجزاء من جنوب الولايات المتحدة والقرن الأفريقي. يمكن للإمدادات العالمية أن تحمي نفسها جزئياً.

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **الأسواق تتكيف.** يغير المزارعون محاصيلهم، ويشتري المستوردون مسبقاً، والمخزونات التي تبدو ضئيلة في التوقعات غالباً ما يتم إعادة بنائها قبل وصول أفق التوقعات.

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **الأرقام المتوقعة هي تقديرات سيناريوهات.** رقم 49 مليون هو توقع نمذجة تحت افتراضات محددة، وليس قياساً. سيتم مراجعته - ومن المرجح أن يكون في كلا الاتجاهين.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: أكثر إعادة صياغة مفيدة هنا هي أن الحدث المناخي وأزمة الغذاء ليسا شيئين مختلفين يفصل بينهما الوقت - بل يفصل بينهما *القرارات*.

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: سواء كان شذوذ هطول الأمطار في عام 2027 سيتحول إلى حالة طوارئ غذائية في عام 2028، يعتمد على توفر البذور، والتخزين، والوصول إلى الائتمان، والسياسة التجارية، وما إذا كانت المساعدات الموضعة مسبقاً ستصل قبل أو بعد أن تبدأ الأسر في بيع ما تحتاجه للتعافي.

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمتسوقين في الولايات المتحدة، التوقعات العملية متواضعة وغير متساوية: حركة بسيطة مرئية في معظم عربة التسوق، مع ضغط أكثر وضوحاً في القهوة والشوكولاتة وزيوت الطهي والأرز والسكر - تصل في أواخر 2027 بدلاً من هذا العام، وتعتمد بشكل كبير على السياسة التجارية التي لا يمكن لأحد التنبؤ بها بعد.

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: بالنسبة لـ 225 مليون شخص يصنفهم برنامج الأغذية العالمي بالفعل على أنهم يعانون من انعدام الأمن الغذائي، فإن الرهانات لا تقاس بنقاط مئوية.

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: هذا التباين - خطأ تقريب في قارة، وموسم عجاف في قارة أخرى - هو أوضح شيء تجعله هذه التوقعات مرئياً.

segments.src: *This article is general information, not financial or investment advice.
segments.tr: *هذا المقال عبارة عن معلومات عامة، وليس نصيحة مالية أو استثمارية.

segments.src: Figures cited reflect projections published by the World Food Programme and are subject to revision; readers should consult WFP, FAO, and NOAA primary sources for current data.*
segments.tr: الأرقام المذكورة تعكس التوقعات المنشورة من قبل برنامج الأغذية العالمي وتخضع للمراجعة؛ يجب على القراء مراجعة المصادر الأساسية لـ WFP و FAO و NOAA للحصول على البيانات الحالية.*

fr.title: Le plus fort El Niño depuis 70 ans est déjà intégré dans le prix des aliments l'année prochaine

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: Les chocs météorologiques et les prix des produits alimentaires fonctionnent selon des cycles différents.

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: L'océan se réchauffe cette année ; les prix en rayon sont révisés l'année prochaine.

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: Cet écart — environ douze à dix-huit mois entre une anomalie de température du Pacifique et le montant au bas d'un ticket de caisse — est l'élément le plus important à comprendre concernant l'El Niño qui se forme actuellement dans le Pacifique équatorial.

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: Les prévisionnistes s'attendent à ce que cet événement se classe parmi les plus forts d'au moins sept décennies.

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: Le Programme Alimentaire Mondial (PAM) des Nations Unies a averti que s'il se développe comme prévu, il pourrait pousser environ **49 millions de personnes supplémentaires vers une faim aiguë d'ici la fin de 2027**, s'ajoutant aux **225 millions déjà classées comme étant en situation d'insécurité alimentaire dans 45 pays**.

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: En réponse, l'agence déclare s'engager à verser environ **80 millions de dollars pour des secours "anticipatifs"** — de l'argent dépensé avant même qu'une seule récolte n'ait échoué.

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: Ce dernier détail est l'essentiel de l'histoire.

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: Les agences humanitaires ne dépensent généralement pas avant une catastrophe.

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'elles le font, c'est un signal qu'il convient de lire attentivement.

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## Ce que fait réellement El Niño

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: El Niño est un réchauffement périodique des eaux de surface dans le centre et l'est du Pacifique tropical.

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: L'eau chaude déplace l'endroit où se situe la convection atmosphérique la plus profonde, et ce déplacement entraîne avec lui la carte mondiale des précipitations.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: Le schéma n'est pas uniforme et n'est pas uniformément mauvais :

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **Plus sec que la normale :** Indonésie, Malaisie, Philippines, est de l'Australie, Afrique australe, parties de l'Amérique centrale et du nord de l'Amérique du Sud, et souvent la ceinture de mousson indienne.

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **Plus humide que la normale :** le sud des États-Unis, la Corne de l'Afrique, les côtes du Pérou et de l'Équateur, parties de l'Argentine et le sud du Brésil.

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **Plus chaud que la normale :** les températures moyennes mondiales grimpent généralement l'année *suivant* le pic, car l'océan libère la chaleur stockée avec un certain retard.

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: Ainsi, un El Niño fort n'est pas une sécheresse mondiale.

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: C'est un *rebrassage* — et ce rebrassage frappe le plus durement les régions qui cultivent des récoltes avec des marges d'erreur étroites et disposent de peu de réserves.

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les dommages arrivent tardivement

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: Le modèle intuitif est erroné.

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: La plupart des gens s'imaginent une tempête, un champ ruiné et des rayons vides la semaine suivante.

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: Les systèmes agricoles ne s'effondrent pas de cette manière.

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: Voici la séquence réelle :

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | Étape | Environ quand | Ce qui se passe |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | L'océan se réchauffe, l'événement atteint son pic | Fin 2026 – début 2027 | Les régimes de précipitations changent ; peu d'impact alimentaire visible |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | La saison des semis est perturbée | Début–mi 2027 | Les agriculteurs plantent tard, plantent moins, ou plantent une culture différente |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | La récolte est insuffisante | Mi–fin 2027 | Les rendements chutent ; les ménages consomment leurs propres stocks plutôt que de vendre |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **Saison maigre** | **Fin 2027 – début 2028** | Les stocks s'épuisent avant la récolte suivante ; les prix grimpent localement |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: La **saison maigre** est l'intervalle entre l'épuisement des réserves d'une récolte et l'arrivée de la suivante.

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: Dans une grande partie de l'Afrique australe, elle s'étend environ d'octobre à mars.

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: Un ménage qui a récolté 40 % de moins que d'habitude ne le ressent pas en juillet — il le ressent en décembre, quand le grenier est vide et que le prix du marché a déjà grimpé parce que le grenier de tous les autres est vide aussi.

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi le calendrier annoncé par le PAM pointe vers **2027–28**, et non 2026.

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: L'événement se produit maintenant.

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: La conséquence est programmée.

segments.src: ## How it reaches a US grocery cart
segments.tr: ## Comment cela atteint le panier de courses américain

segments.src: American consumers are insulated from most of this — but not all of it.
segments.tr: Les consommateurs américains sont isolés de la plupart de ces effets — mais pas de tous.

segments.src: Three things are worth separating.
segments.tr: Trois points méritent d'être distingués.

segments.src: The farm-gate share of retail price is small.** For a box of cereal or a loaf of bread, the raw grain is typically a low-single-digit to low-double-digit percentage of what you pay.
segments.tr: La part du prix à la ferme dans le prix de détail est faible.** Pour une boîte de céréales ou une miche de pain, le grain brut représente généralement un pourcentage à un seul chiffre bas ou à deux chiffres bas de ce que vous payez.

segments.src: Labor, packaging, transport, energy, and retail margin dominate.
segments.tr: La main-d'œuvre, l'emballage, le transport, l'énergie et la marge de détail dominent.

segments.src: A 30% move in wheat futures does not become a 30% move at the register.
segments.tr: Une variation de 30 % des contrats à terme sur le blé ne se traduit pas par une variation de 30 % à la caisse.

segments.src: Some categories are far more exposed than others.** The commodity share is much higher — and the growing regions much more El Niño-sensitive — for:
segments.tr: Certaines catégories sont bien plus exposées que d'autres.** La part des matières premières est beaucoup plus élevée — et les régions de culture beaucoup plus sensibles à El Niño — pour :

segments.src: - **Coffee** (Brazil, Vietnam, Indonesia)
segments.tr: - **Café** (Brésil, Vietnam, Indonésie)

segments.src: - **Cocoa** (West Africa, where rainfall timing matters enormously)
segments.tr: - **Cacao** (Afrique de l'Ouest, où le moment des précipitations importe énormément)

segments.src: - **Palm and vegetable oils** (Indonesia and Malaysia, both classic El Niño dry-signal regions)
segments.tr: - **Huiles de palme et végétales** (Indonésie et Malaisie, toutes deux des régions classiques de signal de sécheresse El Niño)

segments.src: - **Rice** (India and Southeast Asia; also the category most prone to export restrictions)
segments.tr: - **Riz** (Inde et Asie du Sud-Est ; également la catégorie la plus sujette aux restrictions d'exportation)

segments.src: - **Sugar** (India, Thailand, Brazil)
segments.tr: - **Sucre** (Inde, Thaïlande, Brésil)

segments.src: - **Spices, nuts, and tropical fruit**
segments.tr: - **Épices, noix et fruits tropicaux**

segments.src: These are the line items where a Pacific anomaly shows up most legibly in US retail.
segments.tr: Ce sont les postes où une anomalie du Pacifique apparaît le plus clairement dans le commerce de détail américain.

segments.src: Policy amplifies more than weather does.** The sharpest food price moves of the past decade were rarely caused by a harvest shortfall alone.
segments.tr: La politique amplifie plus que la météo.** Les hausses les plus brutales des prix alimentaires au cours de la dernière décennie ont rarement été causées par une seule insuffisance de récolte.

segments.src: They were caused by a shortfall *plus* an export ban.
segments.tr: Elles ont été causées par une insuffisance *plus* une interdiction d'exportation.

segments.src: When a major rice or wheat exporter restricts shipments to protect domestic supply, world prices can move more in a week than a bad monsoon moves them in a season.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'un exportateur majeur de riz ou de blé restreint les expéditions pour protéger l'approvisionnement intérieur, les prix mondiaux peuvent varier davantage en une semaine qu'une mauvaise mousson ne les fait varier en une saison.

segments.src: Watch trade policy at least as closely as rainfall.
segments.tr: Surveillez la politique commerciale au moins aussi attentivement que les précipitations.

segments.src: A fourth, quieter channel: **logistics.** Reduced rainfall in the Panama Canal watershed has previously forced draft restrictions and transit auctions, raising freight costs on routes that have nothing to do with the affected crop.
segments.tr: Un quatrième canal, plus discret : **la logistique.** La réduction des précipitations dans le bassin versant du canal de Panama a précédemment forcé des restrictions de tirant d'eau et des enchères de transit, augmentant les coûts de fret sur des routes qui n'ont rien à voir avec la culture affectée.

segments.src: Shipping is a cost input to everything.
segments.tr: Le transport maritime est un coût d'entrée pour tout.

segments.src: ## Why spend $80 million before anything breaks
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi dépenser 80 millions de dollars avant que tout ne s'effondre

segments.src: "Anticipatory action" is a relatively recent shift in humanitarian practice, and the logic is straightforward arithmetic.
segments.tr: L'"action anticipative" est un changement relativement récent dans la pratique humanitaire, et la logique est une arithmétique simple.

segments.src: Money spent *before* a shock buys different things than money spent after.
segments.tr: L'argent dépensé *avant* un choc permet d'acheter des choses différentes de l'argent dépensé après.

segments.src: Beforehand, it buys drought-tolerant seed, small-scale irrigation repair, veterinary support to keep livestock alive, cash transfers that let families avoid selling productive assets, and prepositioned grain in warehouses reachable before roads wash out.
segments.tr: Auparavant, il permet d'acheter des semences résistantes à la sécheresse, des réparations d'irrigation à petite échelle, un soutien vétérinaire pour maintenir le bétail en vie, des transferts d'argent permettant aux familles d'éviter de vendre des actifs productifs, et des grains prépositionnés dans des entrepôts accessibles avant que les routes ne soient emportées.

segments.src: Afterward, it buys emergency airlifts and therapeutic feeding — the most expensive interventions in the catalogue, delivered at the point of maximum logistical difficulty.
segments.tr: Aprèsward, il permet d'acheter des ponts aériens d'urgence et une alimentation thérapeutique — les interventions les plus coûteuses du catalogue, livrées au point de difficulté logistique maximale.

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: Les agences travaillant sur le financement déclenché par des alertes précoces ont généralement constaté que le dollar prépositionné est considérablement plus efficace que le dollar post-crise, et il y a un second effet plus difficile à quantifier : les ménages qui n'ont pas à vendre leurs bœufs, leurs stocks de semences ou leur toit pour survivre à une saison maigre se rétablissent en un an plutôt qu'en cinq.

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: Les ventes d'actifs sous la contrainte sont ainsi qu'une seule mauvaise récolte devient une décennie de pauvreté.

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: La contrainte n'est pas l'analyse.

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: C'est que le financement anticipatif exige que les donateurs débloquent des fonds en fonction d'une prévision — avant qu'il n'y ait des photos et avant que l'histoire ne soit à la une des journaux.

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: C'est une demande institutionnelle véritablement difficile, c'est pourquoi 80 millions de dollars est un chiffre notable même s'il est faible par rapport à l'échelle des besoins prévus.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut réellement surveiller l'année prochaine

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: Si vous voulez suivre si cela se déroule comme prévu, quelques indicateurs portent la majeure partie de l'information :

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - **Valeurs ONI (Oceanic Niño Index)** publiées par le Climate Prediction Center de la NOAA — la mesure standard de la force de l'événement, et celle qui déterminera si l'affirmation "le plus fort en 70 ans" se confirme.

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **La performance de la mousson indienne de juin à septembre**, et si la politique d'exportation de riz de l'Inde change en réponse.

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **L'indice mensuel des prix des aliments de la FAO**, en particulier les sous-indices des huiles végétales et des céréales.

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - **Les rapports de semis en Afrique australe** à partir d'environ novembre — la première preuve concrète de la production de 2027.

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - **Toute restriction d'exportation annoncée** par l'un des cinq principaux exportateurs de riz, de blé ou d'huile végétale.

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## Les mises en garde honnêtes

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: Les prévisions saisonnières sont probabilistes, pas déterministes.

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: Quelques points méritent d'être retenus :

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **La force ne correspond pas proprement à l'impact.** L'événement de 2015–16 était très fort ; l'événement de 1997–98 était encore plus fort selon certaines mesures, mais a produit un schéma de dommages régionaux différent. L'endroit où se situe l'anomalie chaude dans le Pacifique importe autant que son intensité.

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **Certaines régions gagnent.** Les années El Niño apportent souvent de meilleures précipitations à l'Argentine, certaines parties du sud des États-Unis et la Corne de l'Afrique.

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **Les marchés s'adaptent.** Les agriculteurs changent de culture, les importateurs achètent à terme, et les stocks qui semblent faibles dans une prévision sont fréquemment reconstitués avant l'horizon de prévision.

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Les chiffres projetés sont des estimations de scénarios.** Le chiffre de 49 millions est une projection modélisée sous des hypothèses énoncées, pas une mesure. Il sera révisé — plausiblement dans les deux sens.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: Le recadrage le plus utile ici est que l'événement climatique et la crise alimentaire ne sont pas la même chose séparée par le temps — ils sont séparés par des *décisions*.

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: Le fait qu'une anomalie des précipitations en 2027 devienne une urgence alimentaire en 2028 dépend de la disponibilité des semences, du stockage, de l'accès au crédit, de la politique commerciale et du fait que l'aide prépositionnée arrive avant ou après que les ménages commencent à vendre ce dont ils ont besoin pour se rétablir.

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: Pour les acheteurs américains, l'attente pratique est modeste et inégale : peu de mouvement visible dans la plupart du panier, avec une pression plus notable sur le café, le chocolat, les huiles de cuisson, le riz et le sucre — arrivant fin 2027 plutôt que cette année, et fortement dépendant de la politique commerciale que personne ne peut encore prévoir.

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: Pour les 225 millions de personnes que le PAM compte déjà comme étant en situation d'insécurité alimentaire, les enjeux ne se mesurent pas en points de pourcentage.

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: Cette asymétrie — une erreur d'arrondi sur un continent, une saison maigre sur un autre — est la chose la plus claire que cette prévision rend visible.

segments.tr: *Cet article est une information générale, et non un conseil financier ou d'investissement.

pt.title: O El Niño mais forte em 70 anos já está sendo precificado na conta de alimentos do próximo ano

segments.src: Weather shocks and grocery prices run on different clocks.
segments.tr: Choques climáticos e preços de supermercado operam em relógios diferentes.

segments.src: The ocean warms this year; the shelf reprices next year.
segments.tr: O oceano aquece este ano; a prateleira muda de preço no próximo.

segments.src: That gap — roughly twelve to eighteen months between a Pacific temperature anomaly and the number at the bottom of a receipt — is the single most important thing to understand about the El Niño now building in the equatorial Pacific.
segments.tr: Essa lacuna — aproximadamente doze a dezoito meses entre uma anomalia de temperatura no Pacífico e o número no final de um recibo — é a coisa mais importante a se entender sobre o El Niño que está se formando no Pacífico equatorial.

segments.src: Forecasters expect this event to rank among the strongest in at least seven decades.
segments.tr: Previsores esperam que este evento esteja entre os mais fortes em pelo menos sete décadas.

segments.src: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) has warned that if it develops as projected, it could push roughly **49 million additional people into acute hunger by the end of 2027**, layered on top of the **225 million already classified as food-insecure across 45 countries**.
segments.tr: O Programa Mundial de Alimentos (WFP) das Nações Unidas alertou que, se ele se desenvolver como projetado, poderá empurrar aproximadamente **49 milhões de pessoas adicionais para a fome aguda até o final de 2027**, somando-se aos **225 milhões já classificados como inseguros alimentarmente em 45 países**.

segments.src: In response, the agency says it is committing about **$80 million to "anticipatory" relief** — money spent before a single harvest has failed.
segments.tr: Em resposta, a agência afirma que está comprometendo cerca de **US$ 80 milhões para socorro "antecipatório"** — dinheiro gasto antes que uma única colheita falhe.

segments.src: That last detail is the story.
segments.tr: Esse último detalhe é a história.

segments.src: Humanitarian agencies do not usually spend ahead of a disaster.
segments.tr: Agências humanitárias geralmente não gastam antes de um desastre.

segments.src: When they do, it is a signal worth reading carefully.
segments.tr: Quando o fazem, é um sinal que vale a pena ler com atenção.

segments.src: ## What El Niño actually does
segments.tr: ## O que o El Niño realmente faz

segments.src: El Niño is a periodic warming of surface waters in the central and eastern tropical Pacific.
segments.tr: O El Niño é um aquecimento periódico das águas superficiais no centro e leste do Pacífico tropical.

segments.src: The warm water shifts where the atmosphere's deepest convection sits, and that shift drags the global rainfall map with it.
segments.tr: A água quente desloca onde a convecção mais profunda da atmosfera se situa, e esse deslocamento arrasta o mapa global de chuvas consigo.

segments.src: The pattern is not uniform, and it is not uniformly bad:
segments.tr: O padrão não é uniforme e não é uniformemente ruim:

segments.src: - **Drier than normal:** Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, eastern Australia, southern Africa, parts of Central America and northern South America, and often the Indian monsoon belt.
segments.tr: - **Mais seco que o normal:** Indonésia, Malásia, Filipinas, leste da Austrália, sul da África, partes da América Central e norte da América do Sul, e frequentemente o cinturão de monções da Índia.

segments.src: - **Wetter than normal:** the southern United States, the Horn of Africa, coastal Peru and Ecuador, parts of Argentina and southern Brazil.
segments.tr: - **Mais úmido que o normal:** o sul dos Estados Unidos, o Chifre da África, a costa do Peru e do Equador, partes da Argentina e o sul do Brasil.

segments.src: - **Warmer than normal:** global mean temperatures typically spike in the year *following* the peak, because the ocean releases stored heat with a lag.
segments.tr: - **Mais quente que o normal:** as temperaturas médias globais normalmente disparam no ano *seguinte* ao pico, porque o oceano libera o calor armazenado com um atraso.

segments.src: So a strong El Niño is not a global drought.
segments.tr: Portanto, um El Niño forte não é uma seca global.

segments.src: It is a *reshuffling* — and the reshuffling happens to land hardest on regions that grow crops with narrow margins for error and hold few reserves.
segments.tr: É um *remanejamento* — e o remanejamento acaba incidindo mais fortemente sobre as regiões que cultivam safras com margens estreitas de erro e possuem poucas reservas.

segments.src: ## Why the damage arrives late
segments.tr: ## Por que o dano chega tarde

segments.src: The intuitive model is wrong.
segments.tr: O modelo intuitivo está errado.

segments.src: Most people picture a storm, a ruined field, and empty shelves the following week.
segments.tr: A maioria das pessoas imagina uma tempestade, um campo arruinado e prateleiras vazias na semana seguinte.

segments.src: Agricultural systems do not fail that way.
segments.tr: Sistemas agrícolas não falham dessa maneira.

segments.src: Here is the actual sequence:
segments.tr: Aqui está a sequência real:

segments.src: | Stage | Roughly when | What happens |
segments.tr: | Estágio | Aproximadamente quando | O que acontece |

segments.src: | Ocean warms, event peaks | Late 2026 – early 2027 | Rainfall patterns shift; little visible food impact |
segments.tr: | Oceano aquece, evento atinge o pico | Final de 2026 – início de 2027 | Padrões de chuva mudam; pouco impacto alimentar visível |

segments.src: | Planting season disrupted | Early–mid 2027 | Farmers plant late, plant less, or plant a different crop |
segments.tr: | Temporada de plantio interrompida | Início–meio de 2027 | Agricultores plantam tarde, plantam menos ou plantam uma cultura diferente |

segments.src: | Harvest comes in short | Mid–late 2027 | Yields fall; households eat their own stock rather than sell |
segments.tr: | Colheita insuficiente | Meio–final de 2027 | Rendimentos caem; famílias consomem seus próprios estoques em vez de vender |

segments.src: | **Lean season** | **Late 2027 – early 2028** | Stocks run out before the next harvest; prices spike locally |
segments.tr: | **Estação de escassez** | **Final de 2027 – início de 2028** | Estoques acabam antes da próxima colheita; preços disparam localmente |

segments.src: The **lean season** is the interval between the exhaustion of one harvest's stores and the arrival of the next.
segments.tr: A **estação de escassez** é o intervalo entre o esgotamento dos estoques de uma colheita e a chegada da próxima.

segments.src: In much of southern Africa it runs from roughly October to March.
segments.tr: Em grande parte do sul da África, ela ocorre de aproximadamente outubro a março.

segments.src: A household that harvested 40% less than usual does not feel it in July — it feels it in December, when the granary is empty and the market price has already climbed because everyone else's granary is empty too.
segments.tr: Uma família que colheu 40% a menos que o habitual não sente isso em julho — sente em dezembro, quando o celeiro está vazio e o preço de mercado já subiu porque o celeiro de todo mundo também está vazio.

segments.src: This is why the WFP's stated timeline points at **2027–28**, not 2026.
segments.tr: É por isso que o cronograma declarado do WFP aponta para **2027–28**, não 2026.

segments.src: The event is happening now.
segments.tr: O evento está acontecendo agora.

segments.src: The consequence is scheduled.
segments.tr: A consequência está agendada.

segments.tr: ## Como isso chega ao carrinho de compras dos EUA

segments.tr: Os consumidores americanos estão isolados de grande parte disso — mas não de tudo.

segments.tr: Elas foram causadas por uma escassez *mais* uma proibição de exportação.

segments.tr: Quando um grande exportador de arroz ou trigo restringe os embarques para proteger o suprimento interno, os preços mundiais podem se mover mais em uma semana do que uma monção ruim os move em uma temporada.

segments.tr: Depois, compra-se pontes aéreas de emergência e alimentação terapêutica — as intervenções mais caras do catálogo, entregues no ponto de máxima dificuldade logística.

segments.src: Agencies working on early-warning-triggered financing have generally found the pre-positioned dollar goes considerably further than the post-crisis dollar, and there is a second effect that is harder to quantify: households that do not have to sell their oxen, their seed stock, or their roof to survive a lean season recover in one year instead of five.
segments.tr: Agências que trabalham com financiamento acionado por avisos precoces geralmente descobriram que o dólar pré-posicionado rende consideravelmente mais do que o dólar pós-crise, e há um segundo efeito que é mais difícil de quantificar: famílias que não precisam vender seus bois, seu estoque de sementes ou seu telhado para sobreviver a uma estação de escassez se recuperam em um ano em vez de cinco.

segments.src: Distress asset sales are how a single bad harvest becomes a decade of poverty.
segments.tr: Vendas de ativos por desespero são como uma única colheita ruim se torna uma década de pobreza.

segments.src: The constraint is not the analysis.
segments.tr: A restrição não é a análise.

segments.src: It is that anticipatory funding requires donors to release money against a forecast — before there are pictures, and before the story is on any front page.
segments.tr: É que o financiamento antecipatório exige que os doadores liberem dinheiro com base em uma previsão — antes que haja fotos e antes que a história esteja em qualquer primeira página.

segments.src: That is a genuinely hard institutional ask, which is why $80 million is a notable number even though it is small against the scale of the projected need.
segments.tr: Esse é um pedido institucional genuinamente difícil, e é por isso que US$ 80 milhões é um número notável, embora seja pequeno diante da escala da necessidade projetada.

segments.src: ## What to actually watch over the next year
segments.tr: ## O que realmente observar no próximo ano

segments.src: If you want to track whether this plays out as forecast, a handful of indicators carry most of the information:
segments.tr: Se você quiser acompanhar se isso ocorrerá como previsto, alguns indicadores carregam a maior parte da informação:

segments.src: - **ONI (Oceanic Niño Index) values** published by NOAA's Climate Prediction Center — the standard measure of event strength, and the one that determines whether "strongest in 70 years" holds up.
segments.tr: - **Valores do ONI (Oceanic Niño Index)** publicados pelo Centro de Previsão Climática da NOAA — a medida padrão de força do evento, e a que determina se "o mais forte em 70 anos" se mantém.

segments.src: - **The Indian monsoon's June–September performance**, and whether India's rice export policy shifts in response.
segments.tr: - **O desempenho da monção indiana de junho a setembro**, e se a política de exportação de arroz da Índia muda em resposta.

segments.src: - **FAO's monthly Food Price Index**, especially the vegetable oils and cereals sub-indices.
segments.tr: - **O Índice de Preços de Alimentos mensal da FAO**, especialmente os subíndices de óleos vegetais e cereais.

segments.src: - **Southern African planting reports** from roughly November onward — the first hard evidence on 2027 output.
segments.tr: - **Relatórios de plantio do sul da África** a partir de aproximadamente novembro — a primeira evidência concreta sobre a produção de 2027.

segments.src: - **Any announced export restriction** from a top-five exporter of rice, wheat, or vegetable oil.
segments.tr: - **Qualquer restrição de exportação anunciada** por um dos cinco maiores exportadores de arroz, trigo ou óleo vegetal.

segments.src: ## The honest caveats
segments.tr: ## As ressalvas honestas

segments.src: Seasonal forecasts are probabilistic, not deterministic.
segments.tr: Previsões sazonais são probabilísticas, não determinísticas.

segments.src: A few things are worth holding onto:
segments.tr: Algumas coisas valem a pena manter em mente:

segments.src: - **Strength does not map cleanly to impact.** The 2015–16 event was very strong; the 1997–98 event was stronger still by some measures but produced a different regional damage pattern. Where the warm anomaly sits in the Pacific matters as much as how warm it gets.
segments.tr: - **A força não se mapeia perfeitamente ao impacto.** O evento de 2015–16 foi muito forte; o evento de 1997–98 foi ainda mais forte por algumas medidas, mas produziu um padrão de dano regional diferente. Onde a anomalia quente se situa no Pacífico importa tanto quanto o quão quente ela fica.

segments.src: - **Some regions gain.** El Niño years often bring better rainfall to Argentina, parts of the US South, and the Horn of Africa. Global supply can partly self-hedge.
segments.tr: - **Algumas regiões ganham.** Anos de El Niño frequentemente trazem melhores chuvas para a Argentina, partes do sul dos EUA e o Chifre da África. O suprimento global pode se auto-compensar parcialmente.

segments.src: - **Markets adapt.** Farmers switch crops, importers buy forward, and stocks that look thin in a forecast are frequently rebuilt before the forecast horizon arrives.
segments.tr: - **Os mercados se adaptam.** Agricultores mudam de cultura, importadores compram antecipadamente e estoques que parecem baixos em uma previsão são frequentemente recompostos antes que o horizonte de previsão chegue.

segments.src: - **Projected figures are scenario estimates.** The 49 million number is a modeled projection under stated assumptions, not a measurement. It will be revised — plausibly in both directions.
segments.tr: - **Os números projetados são estimativas de cenário.** O número de 49 milhões é uma projeção modelada sob pressupostos declarados, não uma medição. Ele será revisado — plausivelmente em ambas as direções.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## A conclusão

segments.src: The most useful reframe here is that a climate event and a food crisis are not the same thing separated by time — they are separated by *decisions*.
segments.tr: A reformulação mais útil aqui é que um evento climático e uma crise alimentar não são a mesma coisa separada pelo tempo — eles são separados por *decisões*.

segments.src: Whether a rainfall anomaly in 2027 becomes a hunger emergency in 2028 depends on seed availability, storage, credit access, trade policy, and whether pre-positioned aid arrives before or after households start selling what they need to recover.
segments.tr: Se uma anomalia de chuva em 2027 se torna uma emergência de fome em 2028 depende da disponibilidade de sementes, armazenamento, acesso ao crédito, política comercial e se a ajuda pré-posicionada chega antes ou depois que as famílias começam a vender o que precisam para se recuperar.

segments.src: For US shoppers, the practical expectation is modest and uneven: little visible movement in most of the cart, with more noticeable pressure in coffee, chocolate, cooking oils, rice, and sugar — arriving late in 2027 rather than this year, and heavily dependent on trade policy nobody can forecast yet.
segments.tr: Para os compradores nos EUA, a expectativa prática é modesta e desigual: pouco movimento visível na maioria do carrinho, com pressão mais perceptível em café, chocolate, óleos de cozinha, arroz e açúcar — chegando no final de 2027 em vez de este ano, e fortemente dependente da política comercial que ninguém consegue prever ainda.

segments.src: For the 225 million people the WFP already counts as food-insecure, the stakes are not measured in percentage points.
segments.tr: Para os 225 milhões de pessoas que o WFP já conta como inseguros alimentarmente, os riscos não são medidos em pontos percentuais.

segments.src: That asymmetry — a rounding error on one continent, a lean season on another — is the clearest thing this forecast makes visible.
segments.tr: Essa assimetria — um erro de arredondamento em um continente, uma estação de escassez em outro — é a coisa mais clara que esta previsão torna visível.
